headline: Fuel prices: petrol and diesel rising again | today's prices of August 25 and what will happen tomorrow with the expected Council of Ministers
summary: Petrol and diesel prices rose again on August 25, according to Staffetta Quotidiana data, with a Council of Ministers meeting expected the following day.
why: Fuel prices feed directly into inflation and household spending, and government excise decisions can change pump prices quickly.
